title: "Delete list" sits at the top level of the List settings card
what_happens: A red "Delete list" text button sits on the same line as Save. It does ask twice ("Click again to delete this list"), but it is not inside a "…" menu.
who_hurts: An admin editing the name or description has Delete one row from Save; a quick double click deletes the whole list.
suggested_fix: Put Delete list in a "…" menu on the card (or page header menu) and keep the existing two-step confirm. src/app/admin/lists/[id]/edit-list-form.tsx:117-124.
rule: Dane's UI rule: "Never put a Delete button (or any other destructive action: remove, archive, cancel, void) at the top level of a row, card or page header. It always goes inside a \"…\" actions menu, with a confirmation before it runs."
